Delta plan-repair ledger — 2026-09-05

Audited the prose delta from `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84` through `origin/main@88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684` in the clean code worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/comment-remediation-3e32`. The delta has eight prose-changing paths (+767/-29). No source file was edited.

Eligible changed prose and ownership:
- `tests/_engine_path.py`: four editable blocks (`D:<module>`, `D:engine_root_of`, `D:_foreign_root`, `D:foreign_engine_registrations`) added to `restoring-cynical-woodborer`.
- `tests/_git_upkeep.py`: the changed `D:<module>` remains owned there and new `D:init_bare_remote` was added.
- `tests/conftest.py`: one canonical-engine-root comment region was added there; the adjacent mechanism marker, runtime strings, and concise guard docstring remain protected.
- `tests/integration/test_epoch_guard_reconciliation.py`: `D:_clone_tickets` was added to `capillary-seared-grackle`.
- `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py`: `D:_run_git` was added to `unwitty-meticulous-fieldmouse`.
- New `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py`: four editable blocks (module docstring, `_ALLOWED` rationale, static-test docstring, and `split_engine` docstring; 461 words) had no recorded file-impact owner. Created `filched-disordered-noddy` (`79cf-60f3-7659-4129`) under `popular-stretchy-mussel`, with one exact impact path and this `discovered_from` link.
- New `tests/unit/test_bare_clone_source_upkeep_sweep.py`: three otherwise-editable blocks were identified — `D:<module>@1-39[380]`, `C:<module>:before:EXCLUDED_FILES@59-62[38]`, and `D:_clone_helpers@171-176[38]`. The in-progress implementation ticket `theocratic-actuarial-ibex` already records this exact path in file impact, so no second remediation owner was created. Its remaining comments/docstrings are concise/load-bearing or runtime output.
- `tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py`: the new lines 57-58 comment is a concise, load-bearing canonical-root constraint. `biggish-capturable-magpie` was intentionally left unchanged.

Persisted repairs:
- `restoring-cynical-woodborer` (`107f-7699-bd1f-4833`): 51 exact blocks (40 docstrings, 11 comments; 8,212 words), 19 impacts, six DD commands; description 5,815 characters.
- `capillary-seared-grackle` (`46e0-1134-708b-4752`): 52 exact blocks (35 docstrings, 17 comments; 6,045 words), 13 impacts, six DD commands; description 6,215 characters.
- `unwitty-meticulous-fieldmouse` (`86e6-9562-3d74-40f1`): 33 exact blocks (25 docstrings, eight comments; 3,187 words), 12 impacts, six DD commands; description 5,198 characters.
- `filched-disordered-noddy`: four exact blocks (three docstrings, one comment; 461 words), one impact, six DD commands; description 3,188 characters.

Every plan now uses owner/anchor-qualified stable IDs with immutable spans and before-word counts; strips only allowlisted leading docstrings from `type_comments=True` ASTs; normalizes only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; confines changed base lines to the allowlist; preserves runtime AST, non-allowlisted/inline comments, directives, and shebangs; requires exact one-commit path equality; and requires a non-author one-row-per-block TSV with full immutable citations, reduced word count, and all three PASS fields.

Validation and currency:
- All 24 stored commands passed `zsh -n`.
- All four immutable oracles executed successfully with the pinned base used as both before and after.
- Strict MCP readback matched every description byte-for-byte, all 45 ordered impact rows, and all 24 normalized command triples.
- Before mutation, retained plan-review attestations existed on the three repaired owners; local exact status reported shared-support and integration already `stale-code`, while lifecycle was certified.
- After mutation, shared-support/integration remain `stale-code`; lifecycle is intentionally `stale-material`; the new child is `unsigned`. No plan review was rerun.
- All 13 leaf mutations plus the new ticket's `discovered_from` link returned `push_status.state=ok`, with no admission, duplicate, or cross-session warning.

MCP was used for every tracker write. Earlier bounded MCP list/show reads failed or stalled, so the already-authorized local CLI fallback was used only for read-only ownership/status projection and the exact local plan-currency check. No claim, transition, close, test suite, repository gate, code commit, manual tracker Git operation, or manual push was performed.
